main_staff.abstract:
We implement a ML-based attention framework with component-specific decoders, improving
optical power spectrum prediction in multi-span networks. By reducing the need for in-depth training on
each component, the framework can be scaled to multi-span topologies with minimal data collection,
making it suitable for brown-field scenarios. ©2024 The Author(s)
